Inbound lead from blog post about doc search/RAG. Small engineering team (backend 3 engs, 1 product) building a docs-first search assistant for SMB legal customers. Signed up self-serve, exploring Hosted API first.
- Primary ask: embeddings + reranking flow; want simple flow: ingest -> embed -> store -> query -> rerank with short context.
- Current prototype: extracts text into Postgres, experiments with Milvus for vectors. Asking whether Redwood can: 1) generate embeddings (hosted) and push to their vector DB directly, 2) provide managed connectors to Pinecone/Milvus, or 3) allow storing vectors in customer's DB with simple SDK examples.
- Volume estimate: ~10k docs initial (~1.5-2M tokens), expect monthly growth. Cost-sensitive — wants rough cost estimate for embedding all docs + typical query volume (~5k queries/month).
- Latency/throughput: low throughput, but query latency target ~<300ms for end users; acceptable to cache rerank candidates.
- Model preferences: open to mid-sized open models for cost (Redwood catalog recommended), but wants quality; interested in Redwood recommendations for embedding model + reranking combo.
- Security: SSO/SAML for team, audit logs, and retention controls required. Not immediate EU residency need but likely in 6-12 months for customer base.
- Quote from product lead: "Need something that just works out of the box; our users expect fast, accurate search — we'll iterate on models later."
- Next steps: send Hosted API quickstart + short example showing Redwood embeddings -> push to Milvus and an example reranking pipeline (code snippet). Offer 30m demo next week. AE to share cost estimate and sample billing scenarios.
- Notes: Customer may later request Dedicated if SLA/throughput increases, but for now prefer self-serve hosted due to time to market and lower ops.
- Internal: tag as inbound-docsearch, priority: medium. Monitor for demo scheduling; SE to prepare a short Milvus connector example and cost proforma.
